Proof in the paper: The XRD patterns of the reduced and passivated phosphide catalysts (Fig. 2) showed a broad peak associated with amorphous silica of the MCM-41 support. The Ni-rich samples such as Ni2P/MCM-41, NiMo(3:1)P/MCM-41, and NiMo(1:1)P/MCM-41 presented a series of peaks corresponding to the (1 1 1), (2 0 1), and (2 1 0) reflections which gradually shifted to lower angle from the positions for Ni2P toward those of NiMoP, consistent with the formation of alloys. The Mo-rich sample shows the (1 0 0 1) reflection of MoP also shifted to lower angle. These consistent variations in the XRD patterns give evidence for the formation of the Ni and Mo alloy.
